title: The Rekey Benefit on Bridgewell Closing and New Construction Plans
content:
The rekey benefit of the Real Estate Service Contracts plans is the rekeying of exterior keyed locks for the buyer. Two figures set it per plan: how many locks are rekeyed, and within how many days after closing the benefit must be requested.

| Plan | Exterior keyed locks rekeyed | Request window (calendar days after the closing date) |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Closing Starter | 0 (no rekey benefit) | 30 |
| Bridgewell Closing Standard | 0 (no rekey benefit) | 30 |
| Bridgewell Closing Plus | 6 | 30 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier | 6 | 30 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | 6 | 30 |
| Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year | 6 | 30 |

## Points of reading

- A lock count of 0 means the plan carries no rekey benefit; the Bridgewell Closing Starter and Bridgewell Closing Standard plans are in that position.
- On the four plans with a rekey benefit, up to 6 exterior keyed locks are rekeyed.
- The request window is 30 calendar days after the closing date on every plan.
